description:
Whether the order saved in the caller's TDE account can be placed this month, and how
large, checked month by month against their own cash, budget and stock limits. Needs the
caller to connect their TDE account; takes no figures.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: test_saved_order
title: Your saved order
